# Connecting Dots
> AI and cloud-native engineering blog by Sriharsha CR — practitioner-led posts on enterprise AI adoption, LLMOps, agent architecture, and the patterns that actually matter in production.

## Author
Sriharsha CR — Cloud Native Developer and AI Engineer. GitHub: https://github.com/SriharshaCR
